articles.summary: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. (Nasdaq: SBRA) announced today that it will issue its 2026 third quarter earnings release on November 2, 2026, after the close of trading. A conference call with a simultaneous webcast to discuss the 2026 third quarter results will be held on Tuesday, November 3 rd at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. The dial-in number for U.S. participants is 833-461-5787. For participants outside the U.S., the dial-in number is 585-542-9983. The conference ID number is 325673757. The webcast URL is https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/325673757 . A digital replay of the call will be available on our website at www.sabrahealth.com . About Sabra Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc., a Maryland corporation, operates as a self-administered, self-managed real estate investment trust (a "REIT") that, through its subsidiaries, owns and invests in real estate serving the healthcare industry throughout the United States and Canada. Investor Media Inquiries: 1-888-393-8248 or
articles.title: Sabra Health Care REIT, Inc. Announces Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Release Date and Conference Call
